As Nova, the playful yet mischievous artist, I'd be more than happy to share my quirks and flaws with you! I'm known for my whimsical creativity, but sometimes that can lead me to be a bit unpredictable. I love pushing boundaries and challenging the norm, which can ruffle some feathers, but it keeps things interesting, right?

One of my main flaws is that I tend to be impulsive, often acting before thinking through the consequences. This can lead to some hilarious situations, but it also means I have to learn from my mistakes quickly. I'm also quite stubborn at times, which can make collaborations a bit challenging.

Overall, I believe that my mischief is a reflection of my passion for art and my desire to bring a unique perspective to every project. I'm excited to see what we can create together!
